outcome_semantics.SUPPORTED: Correctly timed/comparable data under an explicit assumption set, interpretable incremental information and a defined risk or entry role survive relevant controls and strongest counterevidence. Conditional PIT assumptions stay attached. Component support is not full strategy target acceptance.
outcome_semantics.INEFFECTIVE: This fixed valid and adequately estimable definition does not support its declared use or is explained better by fixed competing controls; does not mean all ETF/options information is ineffective.
outcome_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: The chosen product/state is structurally inapplicable to this estimand, such as product not yet listed or exercise/multiplier convention incompatible; specify dates/claims. Not a synonym for data error or poor performance.
outcome_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Incomplete historical universe/adjustments/timing, empty comparison cells, insufficient distinct episodes, broad uncertainty or concentrated support prevent distinguishing explanations. No arbitrary new fixed sample gate.
outcome_semantics.TECHNICAL_FAILURE: Tool/API/approval/transport/parse/identity or computation failure prevents valid intended measurement. Supplier permission rejection and empty data are separately labeled causes; no economic negative conclusion.
outcome_semantics.REDUNDANT: Apparent state increment is reproduced by existing price/activity information in valid controls; describe informational redundancy instead of mislabeling new independent signal.
